sloka: असुरा दानवाश्चैव सत्त्ववन्तो महाबलाः ।सर्वे समरमासाद्य न श्रूयन्ते ऽपराजिताः ।। ७.६.३६ ॥
transliteration: asurā dānavāścaiva sattvavanto mahābalāḥ ।sarve samaramāsādya na śrūyante 'parājitāḥ ।। 7.6.36 ॥

translations.english: This verse lists several powerful and deceitful Asuras, including Radheya, Bahumayi, Lokapala, Dharmika, Yamala and Arjuna, Hardikya, Shumbha, and Nishumbhaka.
